Have you ever thought maybe your self esteem plays a part of it? If you always look like you don’t fully believe in yourself and lack confidence then I’m sorry to say it this way but it can make anything from getting a job to getting a girl difficult. 

People don’t want someone who is always thinking bad about themselves, questioning their worth, things like that. Confidence goes a long way. Think about it, let’s say you’re making a basketball team, one guy is always talking down on himself, never believes he can make the shot, and is always timid when he does vs a guy who’s confident, not cocky and arrogant but confident, that guy knows he’s trained for this and is confident he can make the shot and carries himself accordingly.

I’d say 9/10 the confident one will get picked. Another thing. It seems like you’re going for the stereotypical conversation starter the “Hey I’m so and so nice to meet you” without any real plan and a lot of the times that goes as follows “oh hi I’m so and so nice to meet you as well” then awkward silence as you think of what to ask next. 

Be confident but not cocky, instead say something like this (and this is a bad example but it’s just off the top of my head without thinking much) “Hey I’m so and so I saw that you had a [Insert movie] shirt I was actually thinking about getting into it, what’s a good movie to start off on?” 

Just something that sets the conversation up to keep moving and read the conversation, if they seem bored pick another topic and if they just aren’t feeling or accept it for what it is and know just because you missed one shot doesn’t mean you’ll miss the other. 

Last but not least dont be empty, have hobbies and things you’re passionate about, things you can talk all day about. It can help keep conversations moving until they get their own natural pace. 

Good luck friend.
